A Bolognese aristocrat, Nicolosa Sanuti was a learned writer who composed several treatises. She is mostly remembered for an essay she published in response to sumptuary laws enacted in Bologna in 1453. Sanuti, like many wealthy noblewomen, disagreed strongly with male attempts to regulate the dress and jewelry women were allowed to wear.
